Your next chapter, on paper.

Save a clean, selectable-text PDF using your browser’s print window.

In the print window
  1. Choose Save as PDF as the destination.
  2. Turn off headers and footers.
  3. Keep scale at 100% and choose your paper size.

On iPhone, open the print preview, then use Share to save to Files.
